title: Data pillar: the object header moves into the content column, Records / Form / Validations / Hooks / Actions / API / Settings become one underline tab row, and the Records toolbar and grid lose their nested containers
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decisions 1 and 3, open decision B. Measured on objectui main `a2225f91` at `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/data?surface=object:crm_account`: the object header ("Account · crm_account · 37 fields") is a full-width row above the Objects rail, so the title sits over the rail while the content it names starts 208 px to the right; the content column opens with a muted pill group (Records / Form / Advanced ▾) floating in 16 px padding, then a bordered rounded card holding the grid's own toolbar and borders — three nested containers before the first row; the toolbar mixes four labelled buttons with four icon-only buttons and sits right-aligned over an empty left half; the record count is in the footer only.

## Target

The content column (right of the 240 px rail) becomes:

1. **Object header row**, 18 px top padding, 24 px side padding: a 32 px primary-soft tile with the object's icon, the label at 18 px / 600, the api name as an 11 px mono chip, "N fields" at 12 px muted; at the right an Object settings icon button and a more button. The read-only card adds its link here.
2. **Underline tab row**, 36 px, 2 px primary underline on the active tab, 13 px: Records, Form, Validations, Hooks, Actions, API, Settings — the five Advanced entries flattened. **Decision B was answered on 2026-10-15: as designed, seven flat tabs** (the ruling comment on the epic quotes the maintainer's words). Below a `min-width` of 1000 px (container query on the content column) the last five fold back into "Advanced ▾" with the objectui#11794 behavior; above it they are flat.
3. **Records toolbar**, 12 px vertical padding: left — "N records" at 13 px muted, then labelled outline chips (28 px) Hide fields, Filter, Group, Sort with their glyphs; right — search and refresh as 28 px icon buttons with `aria-label`s, a divider, then "Add record" as a primary-soft chip. The grid's own header toolbar is suppressed (`renderStudioGridList` passes the host's toolbar) or, if plugin-grid cannot hide it, this card touches `packages/plugin-grid` only to expose that option.
4. **Grid**, flush with the column: a 1 px top border, a sidebar-tinted header row (36 px, 12 px / 500 muted), 40 px body rows, a 48 px row-number column with 24 px left padding, 1 px vertical dividers, the row actions kebab pinned as the last column. Lookup cells render a 20 px initials avatar plus the display value instead of a primary-colored link. Mono font for autonumber columns.
5. **Footer**, 10 px padding, 12 px muted: "N records" at the left, the range at the right.

The nested card and the pill group are removed. No metadata behavior changes: column inspector, hidden system fields (objectui#11780), grid projection and the Form tab's panels work as before.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`DataPillar`: header, tab strip, Records tab body, `renderStudioGridList`), `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` only if its trigger moves; `packages/plugin-grid` only for the toolbar-suppression option; `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` for tab labels already present under `engine.studio.data.*`.

## Acceptance

1. At 1280 px the object title's left edge equals the grid's row-number column's left edge (24 px inside the content column), pinned by a test comparing offsets or classes.
2. Seven tabs visible at 1280 px; "Advanced ▾" returns below the breakpoint, with the objectui#11794 name rule; `DataPillar.advancedKeepsName-11794.test.tsx` is kept for the folded state and a new test pins the flat state.
3. Every icon-only toolbar button has an `aria-label`; the toolbar has no unlabelled button.
4. `DataPillar.gridProjection`, `gridColumns`, `hiddenSystemFields-11780`, `inspectorBelongsToView-11781`, `surfaceRequest`, `StudioDesignSurface.listViewInspector-11823` stay green.
5. Before/after screenshots at 1280 px, light and dark.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay.
- Gates: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build`; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid test` if touched.
- Lands after the layout skeleton card (the Blocked-by line below).

## Reference artboard

`docs/design/studio-redesign/data-records.html` on objectui main (landed in objectstack-ai/objectui#12458); `data-records.png` is its 1280 px render. The folder's README carries the shared numbers and what a pull request against this card must show: two screenshots per artboard it touches (light and dark, 1280 px, cropped to the artboard's region), a deviation list with a reason per line, and the card's named tests green or updated. Where this card and the artboard disagree, this card's numbers win and the disagreement is reported here.

Blocked-by: #12459
